about.title: About Me
about.bio: I build machine learning systems that make it past the prototype stage. That means the model, but also everything around it: reproducible training, an API that holds up under real traffic, and an interface where the results are actually usable. Working on both sides lets me carry a project from the first experiment to the version your team logs into every morning.

assistant.title: Ask my portfolio
assistant.intro: Ask about the projects on this site and I'll answer from what's actually written here — with a link to the project I'm drawing on. If you'd rather talk to Fernando, say so and I'll pass along your details.
assistant.disclaimer: Answers come from the projects on this site. Anything outside them, I'll say I don't know.
